steps.npc: Welcome my friend to the Old Nite! What can I do for you?
Of course I do! I can offer you a big tasty beer, yours for only two coins.

steps.text: If the player does not have at least 2 coins:

steps.player: Oh dear, I don't seem to have enough money.

steps.npc: No worries, there's a bank just around the corner if you want to grab some coin.

steps.text: If the player has at least 2 coins:

options.text: Your pub looks a bit rough.

steps.player: Your pub looks a bit rough.

steps.npc: It's all part of the aesthetic! Adventurers who've just returned from the fight of their lives don't want a fancy la-de-da establishment like you'd find down south.
They want somewhere to relax and have some hearty ale.

steps.player: And that's what you offer with your broken tables and glass covered floors?

steps.npc: Aye it is, because here at the Old Nite, your safety is our lowest priority!
